reviews.comment:
Jamas cargo combustible aqui, y les voy a explicar porque, los surtidores parecen "arreglados" para despachar menos combustible del que cobran, llamese un "pi-ri-pi-pi", en dos ocasiones me ha pasado que el surtidor despacha mas combustible de la capacidad del tanque del auto! (conozco otras personas que les ocurrio lo mismo), Por otro lado cada vez que cargo aqui el combustible tambien parece rendir menos, agregenle a la lista de quejas que casi siempre hay cola y que los empleados no suelen tener la mejor disposicion o celeridad para atender.

(Translated by Google)
I never fill up here, and I'll explain why. The pumps seem "rigged" to dispense less fuel than they charge for. It's a "pi-ri-pi-pi" problem. On two occasions, the pump dispenses more fuel than the car's tank can hold! (I know other people who've had the same thing happen to them.) On the other hand, every time I fill up here, the fuel also seems to go down. Add to the list of complaints that there's almost always a line and that the employees aren't usually the most willing or prompt in serving.
